Chapter 961  Chapter 20: How Mighty is the Divine Power? (Please Subscribe)

The nine supreme beings of human civilization also appeared on the banks of the River of Time.

Unike the other Twelfth Layer Ultimates, their solemn gazes shifted back to the now calm surface of the river.

Most of the attention of these nine supreme beings was focused on the other Twelfth Layer Ultimates.

Only after witnessing one by one the Twelfth Layer Ultimates gradually disappear did the nine supreme beings sigh in relief for no apparent reason.

"Xuanyuan, what do we do now?"

"Should we still demand an explanation from the Tianyu Clan, Prison Tribe, Insect Race, and the others?"

The Ancient Power Supreme Being asked in a low voice.

This was also the purpose of their hurried arrival.

How could they not seek an explanation when so many Twelfth Layer Ultimates bullied the weaker Galaxy Master, striking against him?

"Seek an explanation?"

Xuanyuan Supreme couldn't help but glance at the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

If things had developed as they had anticipated, with a split presence of the Galaxy Master falling, they would certainly demand an explanation to make those other-race Twelfth Layer pay dearly.

But reality was not as such.

Xuanyuan Supreme even felt some sympathy for Tianyu Chen, the progenitor of the Tianyu Clan, who had suffered such grave injuries that his chances of surviving the impending universal cataclism were very slim.

To demand an explanation at this time... Xuanyuan Supreme worried that it might provoke the Tianyu Clan and lead to a full-scale war between the pinnacle tribes.

"Forget it."

Xuanyuan Supreme said, shaking his head.

Certainly, it was the other-race Twelfth Layer who started the trouble, but with Tianyu Chen's fate, Xuanyuan Supreme felt that it was punishment enough.

After today, the Tianyu Clan will have essentially lost a Twelfth Layer Ultimate, as Tianyu Chen will disappear from the public eye for a prolonged period, inevitably causing the mighty tribe's influence to contract.

The territory that becomes available will likely be uncontested by any other race against human civilization.

After today, the Tianyu Clan will have essentially lost a Twelfth Layer Ultimate, as Tianyu Chen will disappear from the public eye for a prolonged period, inevitably causing the mighty tribe's influence to contract.

The territory that becomes available will likely be uncontested by any other race against human civilization.

...

"The Galaxy Master..."

Before long, the topic among the nine supreme beings of human civilization returned to Lin Yuan.

In his confrontation with over ten Twelfth Layer Ultimates, Lin Yuan displayed a level of strength that utterly shattered the perceptions of the nine human phenomena.

They thought they understood Lin Yuan quite well, much better than those other-race Twelfth Layer did.

Because the nine supreme beings had witnessed the numerous rule models encompassed within the Martial Tao Eleventh Layer, they were aware of Lin Yuan's comprehension of rules, which placed him above all nine of them.

Whereas those other-race Twelfth Layer were only aware of the existence of rule models, having never actually seen them, and could only speculate about the Galaxy Master being the founder of Martial Tao based on such rules' comprehension.

Even Xuanyuan Supreme, including others, never imagined that Lin Yuan's strength would be so formidable.

Comprehension of rules is one thing, but the makeup of strength does not rely solely on that comprehension. What good is it for a commoner to realize the Space-Time Rule? With a weak fundamental strength, they can scarcely threaten high-order evolvers.

"And this is only a split presence of the Galaxy Master; if it were his true Origin Source..."

The Void God Ultimate Being exclaimed in disbelief, as Tianyu Chen's severe injury was largely a result of the River of Time.

However, in the Main Universe, using only his two Primordial Spirits, Lin Yuan managed to overpower Tianyu Chen, which was telling.

If the Primordial Spirits were so powerful, confronting the true body would probably be like facing a formidable enemy for Tianyu Chen.

"It's fortunate that the Galaxy Master is from our human civilization..."

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being muttered to himself.

The other supreme beings heard this and deeply agreed.

If some other race had produced a monstrously strong being like the Galaxy Master, the nine human phenomena would live in constant distress.

Now, it is the Twelfth Layer beings of other races who are plagued by unease because of the Galaxy Master's existence.

...

The Prison Tribe.

Ultimate Lord Fan was extremely astonished; he saw everything in the battle between Tianyu Chen and the Galaxy Master, from the universe to the space of the River of Time.

"How is the Galaxy Master so strong?" asked Lord Fan in disbelief.

While Tianyu Chen's severe wounds were sourced from the River of Time, had it not been for the Galaxy Master dragging him down, the outcome would not be the same.

And is it easy to forcibly drag a Twelfth Layer Ultimate into the River of Time?

"If I was the one who intervened at that time..." Lord Fan's heart shuddered.

Having used the Secret Technique 'Nine-day Worship,' his Origin Source was already weakened.

Had he not cautiously excused himself due to his injuries, temporarily withdrawing from the operation to kill the Galaxy Master,

Perhaps...

Tianyu Chen managed to break free from the constraints of the River of Time because he was at the peak of his strength.

But Lord Fan? His Origin Source weakened and having been dragged into the River of Time, even if he eventually escaped, the injuries suffered would likely exceed those of Tianyu Chen, with a minuscule chance of surviving the great universal collapse.

"Now we're in trouble."

Lord Fan's thoughts spread quickly, soon considering the wider and far-reaching implications.

If the Galaxy Master, not yet a Twelfth Layer, already possessed such power, what about after he enters the Twelfth Layer? Would the universe not then revere human civilization above all, forcing these apex tribe powers to hide within their bastions, not daring to venture out?

"Hm?"

"They're seeking me out?"

Lord Fan's expression shifted slightly as he received messages from other Twelfth Layer Ultimates.

The content was roughly to discuss how to deal with the Galaxy Master.

To be precise, how to deal with the Galaxy Master upon his advancement to the Twelfth Layer.

Currently, the Galaxy Master, with his abnormal strength, was comparable to a Twelfth Layer Ultimate.

The method that severely injured Tianyu Chen relied on the River of Time, and with precautions, it could not be replicated on other Twelfth Layer Ultimates.

But what about the future?

What when the Galaxy Master ascends to the Twelfth Layer?

Everyone is a tier twelve ultimate being, fully aware of the sheer magnitude of transformation one undergoes from the eleventh to the twelfth tier.

By then, the power of the Galaxy Master will undoubtedly skyrocket by a great margin.

...

The territories of the Robber Clan.

A land of mystery and the unknowable.

Scenes keep rewinding in front of the ultimate being of the Robber Clan outside the wooden hut, repeatedly flashing the battle between the Galaxy Master and Tianyu Chen.

"Freak, it's too freakish."

The ultimate being of the Robber Clan outside the hut murmurs to himself, finding the Galaxy Master's power far exceeding his expectation, almost beyond any reason.

"Merely a thousand years old and to possess such strength, could the Galaxy Master be the reincarnation of some unparalleled Great Saint?"

A voice from inside the hut carries over, likewise filled with shock and disbelief.

The origins of the Robber Clan are significant; they hide within the universe to pass through one Cosmic Era after another.

In the Chaos Void, even the Chaos Continents created by the Chaos Venerables have their days of decline, yet the Robber Clan seems almost eternally existent within the universe.

Indeed, the universe will step towards destruction, but it will not be utterly annihilated. After a great calamity, it will be reborn and initiate the next Cosmic Era.

Though as mighty as the Chaos Great Saints, who can induce a universe to collapse ahead of its time, entering a great destruction, they cannot prevent the universe's rebirth.

To completely erase a universe, even beings close to Perfect Time Beings can't achieve it, for it requires contending with the fundamental Dao of the Chaos Void.

And the Robber Clan, capable of entering the next Cosmic Era, is despised by the will of the universe.

Inside the universe, they almost have no natural predators,

Yet the consciousness of the universe has only instinct and will not actively combat the Robber Clan.

"A reincarnated unparalleled Great Saint?"

The ultimate being of the Robber Clan outside the hut falls into deep thought.

At the level of a Chaos Great Saint, if just a trace of the True Spirit is undestroyed, one can undergo 'reincarnation'.

After 'reincarnation,' a Chaos Great Saint will shed all, even their memories will be subject to erosion.

But once a certain realm is reached, or a certain precondition is met, partial memories can resurrect, subsequently rising swiftly.

But Chaos Great Saints capable of reincarnation are too few, with their might, who could force them into reincarnation?

And reincarnation is not without risk. If memories fail to revive on the first reincarnation, the likelihood of regaining them in subsequent ones becomes increasingly slim.

With enough reincarnations, the possibility of revival will be gone.

And this is no different from complete annihilation.

The ultimate being of the Robber Clan outside the wooden hut, though feeling the likelihood of facing a reincarnated Chaos Great Saint is exceedingly low, can only explain the current performance of the Galaxy Master as possibly a reincarnated Chaos Great Saint.

"Perhaps so,"

the ultimate being of the Robber Clan outside the hut muses for a moment and nods in agreement.

...

The battle in front of the space-time black hole, where tier twelve ultimate beings personally took action against the Galaxy Master, ended fruitlessly, and the ancestral founder of the Tianyu Clan, Tianyu Chen, was overpowered by the Galaxy Master and dragged into the river of time, sustaining heavy injuries.

The news spreads among the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky like a hurricane.

"The Galaxy Master beat up the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan?"

"An eleventh tier beating a twelfth tier?"

"I don't believe it, I can't believe it."

The powerhouses among the Starry Sky Races find it unbelievable.

Indeed, the Tier Eleven powerhouses did feel the fluctuations of a Tier Twelve clash, but it never occurred to them that one of them was the Galaxy Master.

However.

As the rumor continues to spread,

none of the tier twelve ultimate beings have denied it.

Especially the ancestors of the Tianyu Clan, who have not shown the slightest reaction.

The powerhouses of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky finally realize that the matter might be true.

The Galaxy Master beating up the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan is essentially using the ancestor as a stepping stone.

If there had been even a slight untruth, it certainly would have been refuted by the ancestors of the Tianyu Clan, and the other tier twelve ultimate beings would not have let such false rumors circulate.

...

The territories of human civilization.

As many evolvers and high-ranking citizens were debating the relationship between the Galaxy Master and the founder of Martial Tao,

they received this news.

"The Galaxy Master... overpowering a tier twelve ultimate being?" The Chikun Star Lord of the Red Kun Lineage, who was instructing a few Disciple Peak Masters, blinked, slightly unable to make sense of the matter.

He knew every word in the message, but somehow when combined together, it seemed so alien?

Overpowering a tier twelve ultimate being?

His junior disciple?

"The Galaxy Master I once sparred with can now beat up a tier twelve?"

Wanyang Holy Son, upon hearing the news from the Wanyang Star Lord, felt an immense shock, even though he had long stopped viewing the Galaxy Master as a rival.

...

As the news spread across human civilization,

countless evolvers boiled over with excitement, for this was even more shocking than a skirmish between tier twelves.

With an eleventh tier overpowering a twelfth tier, it was like an ant shaking a mighty tree.

Galaxy Master.

How majestic is he?

His majesty is unparalleled!
